summary: Frontend-only e2e verification of two changes on plan 'Plan Deporte General - ATR (Issurin)' (Boxeo, 47 sem, v2): (A) Plan Gráfico → Volumen/Intensidad independence and (B) Periodización → Dashboard 'Timeline del Plan' redesign (GanttPlanChart). Both PASS.

issues: Pre-existing a11y warnings: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' and 'Missing Description/aria-describedby'. Non-blocking, already reported in iteration_113.

action_items: (Optional, carried over) Wrap Radix DialogContent titles with VisuallyHidden DialogTitle to clean a11y console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: GraphicPlan.js: Intensidad row correctly renders enableUnits controls (unit-select-intensidad + unit-mode-intensidad found). VOLINT_UNIT_ROWS now includes 'intensidad'.
_buildVolIntData correctly computes vol and int bases independently — verified in UI: editing volumen week 1 to 42 kept intensidad week 1 = 65 (previously bug would zero it out).

DashboardGeneral.js renders <GanttPlanChart/> only when planStore.plan is loaded (post syncFromV1 + cargarPlanCompleto). Confirmed the flakiness note: the Dashboard subtab (view-dashboard) is only mounted inside the plan detail (Datos → Periodización → click into plan Estructura row) — clicking the top-level 'Periodización' icon shows the overview screen with Resumen/Estructura/Carga subtabs; the Dashboard/Estructura/Árbol/Kanban/Tabla/Calendario/Gráfico subtabs (with view-dashboard testid) live one level deeper. This is not a bug per current design but is worth confirming with product.

GanttPlanChart svg is continuously resized via ResizeObserver; Playwright reported 'element is not stable' during scroll_into_view — non-blocking for users but could be smoothed by debouncing width updates.
seed_data_creation: None — used seeded 'Plan Deporte General - ATR (Issurin)' (Boxeo, 47 sem, 5 mesociclos, 4 ses/sem, 188 sesiones). New overrides persisted for the run: intensidad S1=65, volumen S1=42.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reach the Timeline del Plan: login super admin → click 'Planes' in top nav → select 'Plan Deporte General - ATR (Issurin)' → top nav 'Datos' → sub icon 'Periodización' → this shows the overview cards (Periodización/Evaluaciones/Carga/Control) with subtabs Resumen/Estructura/Carga. Click 'Estructura' (or any Periodización subtab besides Resumen) to enter plan detail — this brings the Dashboard/Estructura/Árbol/Kanban/Tabla/Calendario/Gráfico subrow with testids view-dashboard, view-structure, view-tree, view-kanban, view-table, view-calendar, view-chart. Click view-dashboard to see GanttPlanChart (data-testid=gantt-chart) + zoom testids gantt-zoom-semana/mes/trimestre/todo. Plan Gráfico volumen/int controls testids: unit-select-volumen, unit-mode-volumen, unit-select-intensidad, unit-mode-intensidad; cell testids chart-{row}-{week}; edit input chart-input-{row}-{week}.

verified_flows.periodizacion_dashboard_timeline: PASS — [data-testid=gantt-chart] renders. Header 'Timeline del Plan 47 sem'. Legend shows 5 microciclo types + Sesiones: Ordinario/Carga · Choque/Impacto · Competitivo · Recuperación · Sesiones. Zoom controls gantt-zoom-semana, gantt-zoom-mes, gantt-zoom-trimestre, gantt-zoom-todo all present and clickable. Timeline fills full available width in default (Todo) view — no visible cutoff. Material Design cards for Macrociclos/Mesociclos/Semanas/Sesiones present above.

console_errors_observed: One 404 on a resource load (not related to Gantt/Vol-Int flows; no functional impact observed)
rca of the issue: Not applicable — both requested changes verified working. Small note: DashboardGeneral only mounts inside plan detail (selectedPlan must exist in PeriodizationComplete). Reached via Datos → Periodización → click any subtab besides Resumen. GanttPlanChart's ResizeObserver causes brief instability but does not affect UX.
